title: 第一篇 入世 二十五章 乌凡机智胜铁山 获得宝刀不一般第一篇 入世 二十六章 帮助小虫得三拳 行前云浪召北峰
content_zh:
这比武台上惊心动魄的战斗让观战的弟子们是心惊胆战，看见这弟子本来身形瘦弱，突然间变的体型巨大，双目红光，众人不由得暗暗咂舌，这西峰弟子竟如此放肆，居然敢光天化日服用禁药！而几次乌凡陷入险境更让他们神色紧张，可突然间场上就刮起了风！
这一阵风吹起的尘土遮住了双方的视线，却吹散了蒙在乌凡脑子里的乌云，只见他眼神一亮，突然有了主意。趁着铁山还有一段距离，他再次施展土诀直接将铁山连人带甲包裹的严严实实，铁山微微用力，就要再次挣脱，可乌凡怎会再给他机会，右手攥紧拳头在控制着包裹着铁山的泥土，左手向上一指，直接一个泥罐儿凭空出现，然后扣在了铁山的头上。
随着铁山的视线被挡住，整个人仿佛都安静了下来，如同一座巨大的土雕，只听见这座土雕里面传来微弱的声音：“求求你杀了我…我…控制不了…我的身体…”乌凡倒是十分犹豫，没有动手。
云浪真人不知何时来到了台上，听闻此言，无奈的叹了口气，暗念道：“土诀，缩！”只见那座土雕表面小了几圈，里面包裹的铁山咔咔几声就再也没了动静，看着乌凡不解的眼神，云浪说道：“他这次药剂服用过量，就算现在救回来也活不过三天了，还是给他一个痛快吧。”然后向远方一看，“反倒是有辱宗门之人，倒是不能放过！”说着纵身一跃下台就向外面追去。
吕纯看见云浪真人杀伐果断，直接解决了自己的棋子，暗骂一声糟糕！便一猫腰转身便逃，可还没等他跑几步，就见云浪真人已经追了上来，挡在他面前。“吕纯师弟，这是要去哪儿，走的这么急？”“哎哟，师兄，我没事转转。”“转转？你弟子打的正精彩呢，你怎么不去加油打气？”“我那弟子资质欠佳，不知道搞了什么歪门邪道，我去他住处调查调查。”“哼！我看是你搞的歪门邪道还差不多！你看这是什么！”只见云浪真人手中，赫然出现一个药瓶。
吕纯一抹胸口，暗道不妙，他伸手又向里一掏，道：“师兄你这药瓶里可是好东西，我这里倒是还有，都给你吧！”说着掏出一样东西，向地上一摔，只见一股烟雾直接遮住了云浪的视线，然后他神色一厉，“土诀，土刺！”只见身前密密麻麻的土刺嗖嗖的刺向雾中，发出噗噗的声音。
见一击得手，吕纯转身撒腿就溜，可还没迈开几步，就听见身后的声音：“本来还想给你个机会，看来你还是禀性难移！”吕纯回头一看，只见烟雾消散，一排密密麻麻的土刺都钉到了云浪身后的墙上，“虽然不得不留你一条狗命，但是也不能就这么便宜你了！”然后手掌一拍，那些土刺转了个个儿，直接刺向吕纯，把他四肢穿了个血窟窿，钉在了地上嗷嗷乱叫。
因为发生这种事，比武倒是无法继续进行下去了，长老们商议了一下，便作出决定，因为西峰涉及到禁药，所以他们的弟子都直接淘汰了。所以剩下的是乌凡，赵孝忠，以及三名南峰弟子，管事便带领他们来到抽签那个台前。
这一众长老盯着这几名弟子，微微颔首，觉得玉壶宗这次定能名扬四海，然后唤那个管事把奖励取出颁给众人，只见那管事取出一个巴掌小的袋子，就把事先准备好的东西，从里面一样一样的往外掏。这袋子看上去很小，乌凡以为奖励不过是几颗丹药，可没想到这管事如同变戏法一般，没一会就把奖励铺满了桌子。
“好了，桌面上有武器，功法，丹药这几样东西，上面基本都有说明，你们每人从中任选一样吧。”那管事给众人简单的介绍了一句，便向后退了一步，站到了众人身后。
他们几个你看看我，我看看你，也不知道怎么选择，就小心翼翼一样一样的查看着，乌凡一边翻看着一边想，功法我脑子里基本上都有了，只是没有练习，丹药倒是暂时也用不上，我现在只是缺少一把趁手的武器。
一边想着他就来到边上的武器堆中，只见其中有一把大刀尤为醒目，整把大刀用兽皮包裹，刀柄也被红布缠绕，他抽出大刀一看，只见刀身银光闪闪，约二尺有余，靠近刀柄处尤为宽厚，愈往刀尖愈细，如同一只犬牙，再仔细一看发现上面雕刻着奇怪的纹路，仿佛其中有液体流动，刀柄根部刻着两个小字“不器”。
乌凡曾经在奇书上见过“不器”贰字，记得有一把刀是如此描述“古有一樵人，行为善良。初入山砍柴，身携粮饼，偶遇一小兽，分而喂之。再入山，又遇此兽，欣而喂之。久之，成友。一日遇虎，即将丧命。忽闻兽吼，虎流血而亡。回首视之，见一巨兽，昏厥…”
后面的事情说起来就很复杂了，大概意思是说有一个樵夫在山间砍柴时经常遇到一只小兽，然后他心地善良就经常喂它，就成了朋友，一日遇到老虎差点被咬死的时候，突然听见一声巨吼，直接就把老虎吓的七窍流血而亡，他回头一看是一只特别大的野兽，就吓晕了。醒来的时候身边多了一只兽牙，却再也没见到那只小兽，后来他把兽牙带回了家里。这兽牙十分锋利，砍柴劈石如同切豆腐一样，然后这件事传到了当时的王耳中。这位王把樵夫恭请到宫中，为他加官进爵换得此物，又命当时铸器大师—子君，铸造此刃。
子君见此神物，神色也是十分惊喜，双手捧此神物熬了三天三夜，然后才开始锻制。锻制间山间虎啸龙吟，山林间的生物都不敢靠近子君的居所，数日之后，终于锻造结束，取樵夫旧衣紧紧包裹携入宫中。
王只见大殿中，一个粗布包裹里面仿佛有活物一般隐隐欲动。遵从子君的意见，唤来樵夫打开这个包裹。只见包裹打开，大殿中传来一声巨吼，仿佛包裹里面包裹了一只巨兽，而巨兽看见持刀的是樵夫，又化作一个小兽的影子，钻进了包裹中，樵夫弯神一看，里面是一把通体雪白如同兽牙一般的大刀，他伸手握起的瞬间，仿佛整个人充满了力量。
而王让其余几人尝试着接过大刀，却仿佛触碰了一根烧的通红的铁棍，实在无法拿起。王十分高兴，问子君此神器姓名，子君说：“此刀蕴含龙吟虎啸，声若奔雷，持之而立，便可吓退千军万马，我把它唤作—哮牙。”
因为这把宝刀，只有这个樵夫可以驾驭，于是王便封此樵夫为大将军，把“哮牙”赐还予了他。而这樵夫有“哮牙”傍身，整个人变得英勇无比，一人一刀便可孤身抵挡千军万马，所到之处如同奔雷一般，将士们美名其曰“奔雷大将军”。
而有一日妖兽入侵，一方失守，恰逢奔雷大将军及时赶来，他仿佛一朵黑云，直接杀入妖兽当中，这“哮牙”在妖兽中居然也杀出一条重围，引着这群妖兽越来越远，到最后消失再了众人的视线中，过了许久，妖兽也没有入侵，可是奔雷大将军，也再没有回来，“哮牙”也随之消失了。后有人传言在远方的山林里见过一位樵夫，手中一把如同狗牙一般的砍柴刀，但却极为锋利，平时喜欢喂喂小动物，人们都叫他“狗牙樵夫”。
再说子君这个人铸器涉猎广泛，却有一个特点，但凡是自己的作品，他都会在不显眼的地方，刻上“不器”贰字，以表明是自己的心血。

再看手上这把武器虽然形似“哮牙”而神非，但居然也有“不器”的字眼，但应该也是后来人仿造了，乌凡不由得多看了几眼，可他神情一愣，顿时哭笑不得，原来这个器中间的犬字少了一点。所以这把武器的意思就是比“不器”少一点。
反正这把刀倒是很好看，“好看就是好刀”，他第三次想起苍嶙城那小贩的话语…
决定了就是这把刀，乌凡便把它收入兽皮刀鞘中，再看那两个南峰弟子，貌似挑了两瓶丹药，赵孝忠在对着一堆功法犹豫不决，乌凡走近前去，看他手中的几本功法分别是《金体术》《风行诀》《隐息诀》，心里不由得暗暗苦笑，说道：“能不能有点出息，你看看你选的这是什么，一个抗揍的，一个跑路的，还有一个干脆是躲起来的，你就不想选个攻击性的功法吗？”
赵孝忠不好意思的笑了笑：“不是有句老话说的好，打不过就跑吗？我再想如果躲起来被发现了，我打不过可以跑，我跑不过的话，最后是不是选《金体诀》会不会好一点。”“亏你家里人还是武师，怎么你这么胆小！我帮你看看！”然后乌凡便在功法中挑选了起来，他心想这赵孝忠虽然平时胆子小，但是真打起来拳法套路倒是有模有样的，如果选法术类的倒是要重头练习，但是武术类的应该有基础，这个《土行诀》也不行。
可他刚把《土行诀》放下，就看见赵孝忠眼珠子盯着直发光，仿佛如获至宝，“不行！”乌凡翻了个白眼无奈的喊道。正当他摇着脑袋回头继续挑时，突然发现书堆下面漏出了一个拳字，不禁心头一喜赶紧把这本功法扒拉出来，只见这本书上几个醒目的大字《农夫三拳》。
content_en:
The thrilling battle on the competition stage made the disciples watching the battle frightened. Seeing this disciple who was originally thin, suddenly became huge and his eyes were red, everyone couldn't help but secretly smacked their lips. This Xifeng disciple was so impudent and dared to take forbidden drugs in broad daylight! The several times Wu Fan was in danger made them even more nervous, but suddenly the wind blew on the field!
The dust blown by this gust of wind obscured the sight of both parties, but it blew away the dark clouds in Wu Fan's mind. His eyes lit up, and he suddenly had an idea. While Tieshan was still some distance away, he once again used the earth technique to directly wrap Tieshan's armor tightly. Tieshan exerted a little force and was about to break free again, but how could Wu Fan give him another chance? He clenched his fist in his right hand to control the soil that wrapped Tieshan. He pointed upward with his left hand, and a clay pot appeared out of thin air and was clasped on Tieshan's head.
As Tieshan's line of sight was blocked, the whole person seemed to be quiet, like a huge earth sculpture. Only a faint voice could be heard coming from the earth sculpture: "Please kill me...I...can't control...my body..." Wu Fan was very hesitant and did not take action.
Master Yunlang came to the stage at some unknown time. Hearing this, he sighed helplessly and thought to himself: "Tu Jue, shrink!" I saw that the surface of the earthen sculpture shrunk a few times, and the iron mountain wrapped inside clicked a few times and then stopped moving. Looking at Wufan's puzzled eyes, Yunlang He said: "He overdosed on the medicine this time. Even if he is rescued now, he will not live for three days. Let's give him a happy life." Then he looked into the distance and said, "On the contrary, he is someone who has insulted the sect, so we can't let him go!" He jumped off the stage and chased outside.
Lu Chun saw that Master Yunlang was decisive in killing his chess pieces and cursed inwardly, "Oh no!" He turned around and ran away, but before he could run a few steps, he saw Master Yunlang chasing after him and standing in front of him. "Junior brother Lu Chun, where are you going? You're leaving in such a hurry?" "Oh, brother, I have nothing to do." "Turning around? Your disciple is playing brilliantly, why don't you go and cheer him up?" "My disciple is not very qualified and I don't know what evil he did. I went to his residence to investigate." "Hmph! I think you are doing some evil! Look what this is!" A medicine bottle suddenly appeared in Master Yunlang's hand.
Lu Chun touched his chest and secretly thought something was wrong. He reached out and dug inside again, saying: "Brother, there are good things in this medicine bottle. I still have some here. Give them all to you!" He took out something and threw it to the ground. A puff of smoke directly covered Yun Lang's sight. Then he looked sharp and said, "Earth tactics, earth thorns!" He saw the dense earth thorns in front of him swishing into the mist, making a popping sound.
Seeing that the blow was successful, Lu Chun turned around and ran away, but before he took a few steps, he heard a voice behind him: "I wanted to give you a chance, but it seems that your temperament is still hard to change!" Lu Chun looked back and saw that the smoke dissipated and a row of dense soil thorns were nailed into it. He hit the wall behind Yun Lang and said, "Although I have to spare your life, I can't let you go easy like this!" Then with a slap of his palm, the earth thorns turned around and stabbed directly at Lu Chun, piercing bloody holes in his limbs and nailing him to the ground, howling.
Because of what happened, the competition could not continue. The elders discussed it and made a decision. Because Xifeng involved banned drugs, all their disciples were eliminated directly. So what was left was Wu Fan, Zhao Xiaozhong, and three Nanfeng disciples. The steward led them to the drawing stage.
The elders stared at these disciples and nodded slightly, feeling that the Jade Pot Sect would definitely be famous all over the world this time. Then they called the steward to take out the rewards and award them to everyone. The steward took out a bag as small as a palm and put the things prepared in advance from inside.Take it out the same way. The bag looked very small. Wu Fan thought that the reward was just a few pills, but he didn't expect that the steward was like magic, and in a short time, the table was covered with rewards.
"Okay, there are weapons, exercises, and elixirs on the table. There are basically instructions on them. Each of you can choose one from them." The steward gave a brief introduction to everyone, then took a step back and stood behind everyone.
They looked at me and I looked at you. They didn’t know how to choose, so they looked at them carefully. Wu Fan looked through them and thought, I basically have all the techniques in my mind, but I haven’t practiced them, and I can’t use the elixirs for the time being. I just lack a handy weapon now.
While thinking about it, he came to the pile of weapons on the side. Among them, he saw a big knife that was particularly eye-catching. The whole big knife was wrapped in animal skin, and the handle was also wrapped in red cloth. He took out the big knife and saw that the blade was shining with silver and was about two feet tall. It is particularly wide and thick near the handle, and becomes thinner towards the tip, like a canine tooth. If you look closely, you will find that there are strange lines carved on it, as if there is liquid flowing in it, and two small characters "无码" are engraved on the root of the handle.
Wu Fan once saw the word "Buqi" in a strange book, and remembered that a knife was described like this: "In ancient times, there was a woodcutter with good behavior. He first went into the mountain to cut firewood, carrying grain and cakes. He met a small beast by chance and fed it. Then he went into the mountain again and met this beast again. He happily fed it. Over time, they became friends. One day he met a tiger and was about to die. Suddenly he heard the roar of the beast and the tiger bled to death. Looking back, he saw a huge beast and fainted..."
The following story is very complicated. It probably means that there was a woodcutter who often encountered a small beast when he was chopping firewood in the mountains. He was kind-hearted and often fed it, and they became friends. One day, when he met a tiger and was almost bitten to death, he suddenly heard a loud roar, which frightened the tiger until it bled to death. When he turned around and saw that it was a particularly large beast, he fainted from fright. When he woke up, there was a beast fang next to him, but he never saw the little beast again. Later, he took the beast fang home. The teeth of the beast were so sharp that cutting wood and rocks was like cutting tofu. Then the story reached the ears of the king at that time. The king respectfully invited the woodcutter to the palace and promoted him to a noble rank in exchange for this thing. He also ordered Zijun, the master forger at the time, to cast this blade.
When Zijun saw this magical object, he looked very surprised. He held the magical object in his hands for three days and three nights before starting to forge it. Tigers roared and dragons roared in the mountains during the forging process, and the creatures in the mountains and forests did not dare to approach Zijun's residence. After a few days, the forging was finally completed, and the woodcutter's old clothes were wrapped tightly and brought into the palace.
The king saw a coarse cloth package in the main hall, as if there was a living thing about to move. Following Zijun's advice, he called the woodcutter to open the package. I saw the package opened, and a huge roar came from the hall, as if a giant beast was wrapped in the package. When the giant beast saw that the person holding the knife was the woodcutter, it turned into the shadow of a small beast and got into the package. The woodcutter bent over and saw that inside was a large knife that was as white as an animal's teeth. The moment he stretched out his hand to hold it, his whole body seemed to be filled with power.
Wang asked the others to try to take the sword, but it seemed like it had touched a red-hot iron rod and they couldn't pick it up. The king was very happy and asked Zijun the name of this magical weapon. Zijun said: "This sword contains the roar of dragons and tigers, and the sound is like thunder. If you hold it upright, it can scare away thousands of troops. I call it - Roaring Fang."
Because only the woodcutter could control this sword, the king named the woodcutter a general and gave him the "Snarling Tooth". And this woodcutter has "roaring teeth" by his side, and he becomes extremely brave. One man can withstand thousands of troops with one sword. Everywhere he goes is like thunder, and the soldiers call him the "Thunder General".
One day, monsters invaded and one side fell. General Ben Lei arrived just in time. He was like a black cloud., directly charged into the monster beasts, this "Snarling Fang" actually created a tight encirclement among the monster beasts, leading the group of monster beasts farther and farther away, and finally disappeared from everyone's sight. After a long time, the monster beasts did not invade, but General Ben Lei never came back, and "Snarling Fang" also disappeared. Later, it was rumored that a woodcutter was seen in the distant mountains and forests. He had a woodcutter in his hand that looked like a dog's tooth, but it was extremely sharp. He liked to feed small animals, so people called him the "dog-tooth woodcutter."
Besides, Zijun has a wide range of craftsmanship, but he has one characteristic. He will engrave the word "buqi" on any of his works in an inconspicuous place to show that they are his own hard work.
Looking at the weapon in his hand, although it looks like a "roaring tooth" but has a different look, it actually has the word "无码" in it, but it must have been imitated by someone later. Wu Fan couldn't help but look at it a few more times, but he was stunned, and he didn't know whether to laugh or cry. It turned out that the word "dog" in the middle of the weapon was missing a little. So the meaning of this weapon is a little less than "no weapon".
Anyway, this knife is very beautiful. "A good-looking knife is a good knife." For the third time, he remembered the words of the vendor in Cangga City...
Deciding that this was the sword, Wu Fan put it into the animal skin scabbard. Looking at the two Nanfeng disciples, they seemed to have picked two bottles of elixirs. Zhao Xiaozhong was hesitant about a bunch of exercises. Wu Fan walked closer and saw that the several exercises in his hand were "Golden Body Technique" and "Golden Body Art". "Wind Movement Technique" and "Hidden Breath Technique", he couldn't help but secretly smile bitterly in his heart, and said: "If you can have some potential, look at what you chose. One is to resist beating, one is to run away, and one is simply hiding. Don't you want to choose an offensive technique?"
Zhao Xiaozhong smiled sheepishly: "Isn't there an old saying that says, if you can't beat me, just run away? I think again if I hide and get discovered, I can run away if I can't beat you. If I can't run, would it be better to choose "Golden Body Jue" in the end?" "Thanks to your family for being martial arts masters, why are you so brave? Xiao! Let me help you check it out!" Then Wu Fan started to choose among the exercises. He thought that although Zhao Xiaozhong was usually timid, his boxing routines were quite impressive. If he chose spells, he would have to practice them all over again, but he should have a basic foundation in martial arts, and this "Tou Xing Jue" was not good.
But as soon as he put down "Earth Elements", he saw Zhao Xiaozhong's eyes shining brightly, as if he had found a treasure, "No!" Wu Fan rolled his eyes and shouted helplessly. Just as he was shaking his head and turning back to continue picking, he suddenly found the word "Fist" missing from under the pile of books. He couldn't help but feel happy and quickly pulled out the book of Kung Fu. He saw several eye-catching large characters "Farmer's Three Fists" on the book.
